subject.title: feat(signal): add chat-based setup and account linking

question: Should OpenClaw adopt chat-hosted Signal device linking as a supported cross-client setup capability, rather than limiting Signal linking to the existing terminal workflow?
rationale: This is a broad new setup experience spanning gateway protocol, shared wizard lifecycle, web UI, Android, iOS, macOS, and persisted Signal configuration; implementation quality alone cannot decide its product scope.

options.title: Sponsor the chat setup direction
options.body: Keep the feature direction and require current-base live Signal proof plus explicit fresh-install and upgrade validation before merge.

options.title: Narrow to plugin and terminal setup
options.body: Retain Signal setup improvements without adding the cross-client QR and hosted-wizard protocol surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the chat setup direction
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction and require current-base live Signal proof plus explicit fresh-install and upgrade validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows continuous authorship of the related Signal setup design and this chat-based extension.
